name: bloodscribe-creator
description: Create BloodScribe characters, icons, rules, and tales with your own AI and BloodScribe Creator MCP.

interface.longDescription: Guides your AI through characters, icons, rules, tales, mechanic recipes, and deterministic Creator validation without calling BloodScribe's internal AI.
defaultPrompt: Create a BloodScribe character from my idea.
Create a styled SVG icon for my BloodScribe character and ask how I want the result delivered.
Create a game-end rule and link it to my tale.
Create or modify a BloodScribe tale.
